description: This file defines the Country controller class for the OpenCart admin module, supporting country data management tasks such as listing, retrieving information, and cleaning up JSON files.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class for managing country-related tasks in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing countries, fetching details, and cleaning JSON data files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes country task list by clearing previous tasks and creating new ones.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a list of countries, saves data into a JSON file, and schedules info tasks for each country.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides detailed info for a specific country, including zones, and saves it as a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated country JSON files to clean up data.
